This directory adapts the Schoenflies development by Álvaro Begué from LeanPool/lean-pool, commit `86da5902e640ceb44e53f88c4a04f870dc062126`, under Apache-2.0. The complete pinned license and original author headers are retained. `UPSTREAM.json` records each source Git blob, SHA-256, local file and declaration correspondence, and the complete local changes. Original mathematical namespaces are retained except for the upstream bridge predicate `Graph.IsBridge` and its four child lemmas, consistently renamed under `Graph.SchoenfliesIsBridge` to coexist with Mathlib’s distinct predicate of the former name. The exact map is recorded in `UPSTREAM.json`. Source declarations and generated kernel symbols are counted separately. The upstream Jordan and crosscut theorems are unconditional; the project consumer proves crossing for actual connected traces in the round unit ball. These topological prerequisites alone do not establish the polygon side-pairing criterion.
